mathematical_review: Each new indicator is the AND of all three original triangle edges, including its target central edge.

When a target is absent, every incident indicator is zero while its two-edge common-neighbor paths remain allowed. A side-edge-only AND would incorrectly remove those assignments; this source does not use it.
When a target is present, its accepted exactly-one-exterior-common-neighbor premise and the complete accepted support table give exactly one live triangle indicator.

Every omitted support has a triangle-cover or existing-zero reason in the bound support ledger. The inventory rechecks every final live-index list against that ledger's complete table and final zero set.
The four bounded linear rows are exactly three upper AND bounds and one lower AND bound on Boolean variables. All extra domain endpoints are redundant Boolean-box bounds.
Selector activation follows from indicator<=edge and the existing endpoint activations; no new selector guard is missing.
Every actual graph extends uniquely. This represents an additional necessary consequence in the relaxation and is not claimed equivalent to the previous relaxation.
implementation_review: The five exact premise hashes fix the accepted support ledger, successful finalization, execution gate/configuration and current model acceptance.
The 132 targets are partitioned into 48 already-zero targets and 84 surviving targets; zero new edge zeros is checked explicitly.
The inventory preserves each target's accepted spectral premise index and every live support's original table/index.
Both directions of original edge-ID/endpoint identity are checked. Sorted vertex triples deduplicate shared indicators while retaining all target origins.
Target-to-triple incidence totals equal the total saved origins; a triple serves at most its three edges.
New indices start at 68934. All original 68934 variables and 257594 rows remain in the proposed dimensions.
For T triples and I target incidences, additions are T Boolean variables, 4T+84 rows and 10T+I+84 terms.
The source emits only identities, dimensions and templates. It does not rebuild the original support domain or construct a native model.
